added Add and List for Level-2
Introduce Task classes and add in mark/unmark for Level-3
Add task serialization and file storage

commitResults.messageBody: Move command input and all user-facing formatting from Eden into a dedicated Ui class. Keep command parsing, task mutations, and persistence orchestration unchanged so the refactor establishes one owner for terminal behavior without changing observable output.

Promote Storage, the task collection, and Ui to Eden fields, initialize them in a constructor, and move the command loop into run(). Keep main as a minimal entry point and retain the existing failed-load exit behavior through an explicit readiness state.

Introduce TaskList as the owner of task structure, one-based task-number conversion, and add/delete/mark/unmark operations. Defensively copy loaded tasks and expose only an unmodifiable view to Ui and Storage, then update Eden to coordinate through the new abstraction without changing behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Introduce command abstraction for list and exit
commitResults.messageBody: Add an abstract Command protocol with execute and exit signaling, then migrate the argument-free list and bye actions into ListCommand and ExitCommand. Update Eden's loop to execute these objects polymorphically while leaving parsing-heavy commands inline for later incremental migration.

Keep src/main/java as the source root while grouping the composition root, commands, parser types, exceptions, storage, tasks, and UI into focused eden subpackages. Update imports and remove the task-to-storage Javadoc reference so package dependencies remain one-directional and acyclic.
Bring the maintained Gradle wrapper and baseline Java application build configuration from the se-edu Duke starter branch into Eden.

commitResults.messageTitle: Configure Gradle for the Eden application
commitResults.messageBody: Select the Java 25 toolchain so Gradle builds with the project-required language version. Point the application plugin and generated launchers at eden.Eden, name the shaded artifact eden.jar, and set the root project name to Eden for consistent build outputs.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit coverage for storage and task lists
commitResults.messageBody: Verify Storage load/save behavior across missing files, nested directories, every task type, escaped text, replacement writes, malformed records, and filesystem failures using isolated temporary directories. Cover TaskList one-based mark, unmark, and delete operations together with collection encapsulation and invalid indexes so regressions are caught without changing production code or repository data.

Document every non-private production declaration, inherited command and task behavior, command type, and public test case so the generated API reference meets the stretch goal. Clarify loading failures, working-directory storage, task-number bounds, escaping, and input-line behavior to keep the documentation aligned with the implementation. Explicit no-argument constructors preserve the existing command API while making constructor documentation visible.
